output.text:
I added `worklog total --week`, but I couldn't run the tests: running `npm test` needs your approval, so I haven't confirmed any of this works.

**What changed:**
- **`lib/commands.js`**: `total` now takes a `--week` switch. With it, only entries from this week's Monday through today are counted, including both ends. Entries dated after today are left out. It works together with `--project`, and the usage line now shows `[--week]`. It reuses the existing `days.mondayOf`, `days.today` and `days.inRange` helpers, so Sunday counts as the last day of the week. For today (Wednesday 2026-11-11), that's 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-11.
- **`test/commands.test.js`**: two new tests:
  - Entries from last Sunday and from tomorrow are left out, while entries from Monday and today are counted.
  - `--week` works together with `--project`.

  Both tests work out their dates from the real current day, so they won't go stale.
- **`README.md`**: added a `total --week` example.

To check it, run `npm test`, or try `node bin/worklog.js total --week` against your `worklog.json`.
